Meaning: Mains, AC or, with vibrator, DC

Note:
Suffix, a slash and two digits, is optional and can mean almost anything, including indication of development centres, technical fixing, and manufacturing for specific market (code .X..../29 seems to indicate “made in Holland for export to France”). We have seen /25 to denote suitability for 25 Hertz main power.
Sometimes radio documentation comes with an additional sheet to document a technical modification, which comes with a different execution suffix.
